prompt:
REFERENCE ROLE: use the supplied atlas ONLY for its precise regular THREE columns by FOUR rows geometry, square panels and warm natural photographic style. Replace ALL twelve photographs with the following new scenes; do not keep breakfast pictures except where the new sentence specifically calls for one. Preserve total width:height THREE:FOUR (0.75), twelve equally sized SQUARE cells and thin continuous pure white gutters. NOT a 1:2 canvas.
Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE English Patterns learning atlas.
Pattern context: I never + فعل مثبت (بدون don't). Style: Photorealistic everyday editorial photography, warm natural light, coherent with the existing learning atlases.
Canvas width:height MUST be THREE:FOUR (0.75), not 1:2. Exactly 3 columns by 4 rows of SQUARE photographic cells, with narrow continuous pure white divider gutters. All twelve cells visible. Final display contract 1536x2048.
Conservative Arab Muslim family learning contexts. Men wear loose opaque long-sleeved high-neck shirts and full-length trousers or thobes. Women wear loose opaque full-coverage clothing and hijab. Apply modest clothing to background people too.
No bare torso, shoulders, midriff or thighs, tight or transparent clothes, revealing nightwear, swimwear, underwear, changing, bathing, showering, intimate or romantic poses, kissing or inappropriate physical contact.
Water and beach contexts use fully clothed people on a dry shore, promenade or empty poolside. Never show swimmers, sunbathers, mixed bathing or distant revealing figures. Depict swimming discussions before the activity, with equipment where useful.
No alcohol, gambling, nightclub setting, graphic injury, active weapon violence, or religious caricatures. Use ordinary respectful Arab settings without adding religious rituals unrelated to the sentence.
Preserve the exact English sentence and Arabic meaning. Adapt only the visual staging. If a compliant scene cannot convey the meaning honestly, hold the cell for review instead of substituting an unrelated picture.
No captions, words, numbers, logos, speech/thought bubbles, graphic overlays or floating inset pictures. Physical analog clocks can use hands and tick marks for time examples.
Exactly three columns and four rows in row-major order, twelve square cells, portrait 3:4, final atlas 1536x2048, 512x512 per cell with 40px safe inset and continuous straight white dividers. Measure actual source gutters before preparing the display atlas.
The following English sentences are context only: do not render their text. Exact panel order, left to right then top to bottom:
1. Meaning: I never skip breakfast. Visual staging: An adult explaining a personal habit or a firm personal choice. Specific context: I never skip breakfast. No captions or written speech.
2. Meaning: I never forget my school bag. Visual staging: An adult explaining a personal habit or a firm personal choice. Specific context: I never forget my school bag. No captions or written speech.
3. Meaning: I never drink coffee at night. Visual staging: An adult explaining a personal habit or a firm personal choice. Specific context: I never drink coffee at night. No captions or written speech.
4. Meaning: I never go to bed very late. Visual staging: An adult explaining a personal habit or a firm personal choice. Specific context: I never go to bed very late. No captions or written speech. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
5. Meaning: I never share my password with anyone. Visual staging: An adult protecting a laptop screen while signing in.
6. Meaning: I never leave my bike unlocked. Visual staging: An adult locking a bicycle to a secure stand.
7. Meaning: I never use my phone while I drive. Visual staging: A driver placing a phone safely away before driving.
8. Meaning: I never buy food without checking the date. Visual staging: An adult checking a food package in a grocery store.
9. Meaning: I never throw rubbish in the street. Visual staging: An adult placing litter in a street bin.
10. Meaning: I never make a promise that I cannot keep. Visual staging: Two adults having a thoughtful serious conversation.
11. Meaning: I never take someone else's seat without asking. Visual staging: An adult asking a seated passenger about an empty chair.
12. Meaning: I never stop learning, even when I make mistakes. Visual staging: An adult correcting a notebook exercise and continuing to study.


Mandatory staging refinements: Cell1 adult actually eating a complete breakfast. Cell2 adult at doorway deliberately holding their school backpack ready to leave. Cell3 adult at night gently refusing a coffee cup and choosing a clear glass of water; DO NOT show drinking coffee. Cell4 fully clothed adult in loose long sleeves and full-length trousers/thobe, calmly switching off a bedside lamp beside a clock showing a reasonable early bedtime; blankets, no exposed lower legs. Cell5 laptop screen turned away from another person; keep screen unreadable and password private, no text overlay. Cell6 show a physical bicycle lock secured to a rack. Cell7 vehicle parked, driver buckled in placing phone in closed console before moving; no phone use while driving. Cell8 shopper inspecting date label area on sealed halal food packet, no readable text. Cell9 placing rubbish into an actual street bin. Cell10 two same-gender modestly dressed men making a thoughtful reliable commitment in conversation, no physical contact. Cell11 standing fully clothed man politely asks a seated male passenger before taking a clearly empty adjacent seat. Cell12 learner calmly correcting work and continuing, not giving up, no readable writing. All women in hijab and loose full-coverage opaque clothing; all men in full-length loose garments. Clothing and modesty apply to every background figure. No floating signs or graphic symbols. Keep essential objects/faces within safe inset.
